description: This file contains Swagger API schema definitions for role-related endpoints in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) used for API responses and requests related to roles, their permissions, and CRUD operations.

classes.name: RolesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A final class containing nested static classes that define Swagger schemas for role-related API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetRolesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when retrieving a list of roles.

classes.name: GetRolesRoleIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when retrieving a specific role by ID.

classes.name: PostRolesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new role request payload.

classes.name: PostRolesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new role, containing the resource ID.

classes.name: PutRolesRoleIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating role details, such as description.

classes.name: PutRolesRoleIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a role, including resource ID and changes.

classes.name: PostRolesRoleIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a role with a specific ID.

classes.name: GetRolesRoleIdPermissionsResponse
classes.description: Schema representing permissions associated with a specific role, including a collection of permission data.

classes.name: PutRolesRoleIdPermissionsRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating permissions for a role, using a map of permission codes to boolean values.

classes.name: PutRolesRoleIdPermissionsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating permissions, including resource ID and changes.

classes.name: DeleteRolesRoleIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a role, returning the resource ID.
